brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy (a storage tidy for sewing supplies)
requirements.evidence: One hex base (piece) with a full-depth, 3-compartment bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3) and closed faces via capOpenFaces, joints locked. Mesh check clear, no rule issues. It gives three separate compartments for small notions. Dressed with a marker and a pen standing in two compartments as a sample. The pencil would not stay posed and was left out; the steel rule (300 mm) does not fit the 124 mm compartments and was left out.

requirements.requirement: Compartments sized for sewing items (spools, scissors, pins, buttons)
requirements.evidence: The configurator has no sewing-specific props. The compartments are about 44 x 124 mm and 64-73 mm deep, so small notions fit, but spools and scissors were not modelled as props.

finish.summary: I built a small sewing tidy: one hex base holding a full-depth bin split into three compartments, with all open faces capped and joints locked. The check is clear with no rule issues. I dressed two compartments with a marker and a pen. The configurator has no sewing-specific props, and the 300 mm ruler and pencil did not fit, so they were left out. The build is a single cell, so storage is limited; more bases could be added if more room is needed.
